title: NET Toolkit
summary: 口袋网络运维工具箱:Ping/路由/端口扫描/DNS/ARP/局域网发现/SSH/Telnet/串口/接口配置/文件投送。
description:
NET Toolkit 是运行在 CardputerZero 主机上的随身网络运维工具,把现场调试与日常排障装进 320×170 小屏。
· 接口配置:有线/无线/USB 网卡 IP/掩码/网关/DNS,支持 DHCP 与静态。
· Ping / 路由追踪(到达即停)/ 端口扫描(多选+自定义端口)/ DNS(解析真实 IP+运营商地区)/ ARP(IP→MAC→厂家识别)。
· 局域网扫描:自定义网段(掩码支持完整或缩写),ARP 发现存活设备并识别厂家。
· SSH / Telnet / 串口控制台:会话书签、回滚滚动、Ctrl+S 保存、Ctrl+C 停止、长按回车连续输出。
· 文件投送:局域网 HTTP 一次性 PIN 上传/下载。
· 体验:中英切换、多套明暗配色一键循环、结果历史保存/导出、标题栏实时显示接入接口与 IP。
单文件自包含安装,不依赖 root 服务,普通用户即可使用。
NET Toolkit is a pocket network operations toolkit for the CardputerZero Debian handheld, fitting switch/router field work and everyday troubleshooting onto a 320×170 screen.
Features:
· Interfaces: view/edit IP, netmask, gateway and DNS for wired, wireless and USB adapters; DHCP or static.
· Ping / Traceroute: ping any hostname or IP; hop-by-hop trace that stops automatically when the destination is reached.
· Port scan: multi-select checklist of common ports plus custom ports.
· DNS lookup: resolve a hostname to its real IP and show the ISP/region.
· ARP resolve: IP to MAC with OUI vendor lookup; randomized MACs get a device-type hint.
· LAN scan: custom network address and netmask (full or prefix length), discover live hosts and their vendors.
· Remote console: SSH / Telnet / serial (port and baud selectable) with bookmarks, scrollback, Ctrl+S save, Ctrl+C stop and hold-Enter to keep output flowing.
· File drop: LAN HTTP upload/download with a one-time PIN.
· UX: Chinese/English switch, multiple light/dark color schemes cycled with one key, saved/exportable result history, live interface + IP in the title bar.
Self-contained single package; no root service; runs as a normal user.
